ev.q: With its relatable humor, endearing characters, and heartwarming moments
It is comforting, refreshing, and just what you need to get through the chaos of life
The show revolves around the relatable story
starring Abhishek Chauhan, Arnav Bhasin, Shivankit Singh Parihar, and Badri Chavan, among others
leaving the narrative feeling convenient and stagnant compared to earlier seasons
Issues are resolved too quickly, robbing them of emotional weight
